messages:
tess: Quick heads up 15 10m until our release apply window. We need a branch lock and a human breakpoint before iam changes.
omar: I can be latch-holder for first 20m. Will monitor plan outputs and route logs.
maria: Good. Decision matrix: immediate rollback on any of: state-lock failure during apply, terraform plan drift removing production SGs, or >7% backend 5xx for 3m.
kai: Can deploybot pause automatically on "plan.diff has resource deletion"? We should not rely on manual scanning for that.
dev-deploybot: deploybot: scheduled serial apply (canary->prod) in 8m. Behavior: pause-on-diff=true, require-reaction=true. Pauses at module boundaries: networking, iam, load-balancer. Pin map: provider aws ~>4.62.0, terraform = 1.6.5, modules pinned to tag release-2026-03-21.
tess: Nice. Add explicit plan artifact attach so we can diff in-thread.
omar: preflight command I pushed to CI: ```bash
terraform init -upgrade=false
terraform plan -var-file=release.tfvars -out=release.plan
terraform show -json release.plan > release-plan.json
```I'll attach release-plan.json before apply.
sre-marc: Post-apply smoke: 3x healthchecks (api/ingress/db) + traces verify no error-rate regression. If trace-error-rate > baseline + 5% we open pager and trigger rollback.
ops-oncall: Escape hatch: state revert lambda ready, must be invoked by oncall + two engineers. Also have a network-route restore script in case BGP flaps.
maria: Rollback playbook (short): ```bash
# cancel remaining applies
deploybot cancel --run $RELEASE_TAG
# checkout last known prod state branch
git checkout release/last-stable && git reset --hard origin/release/last-stable
# targeted tf restore for problem module
cd infra/terraform && terraform apply -target=module.iam -var-file=rollback.tfvars -auto-approve
# quick network restore
./scripts/restore-bgp.sh --snapshot snap-2026-03-20
# run post-rollback smoke checks
./scripts/postapply-smoke.sh --strict
```
kai: For traffic cutover we'll use shadow traffic then 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% with 3m observation windows. Any window with >7% 5xx aborts and revert to previous weight.
tess: Also note: we pinned provider so provider upgrade won't surprise us, but double-check providers.lock in branch.
dev-deploybot: deploybot: preflight check results: state-lock ok, backend reachable, plan artifact attached: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1763700012/release-plan.json. Will start first module apply in 6m and pause after networking.
omar: I'll watch for any deletions flagged in the plan JSON. If I see unexpected delete, I'll react with :x: and deploybot should halt.
sre-marc: small change request: include a short-lived feature-flag toggle so we can kill new path on error without infra rollback. Anyone object?
maria: Agree, add feature flag toggle to release notes and plan vars. Keep it simple.
ops-oncall: Added oncall rotation to runbook and pager contact. If we escalate, call the emergency number first.
kai: acked. I'll take latch at t+20m and post "handoff" when I take it.
tess: Branch locked and release note updated: https://internal.redwood/release/notes/2026-03-21. Good luck all 44d
